FN-98VTBBB-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 122
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 122 as introduced would reduce potential future receipts collected from provisional
license fees by the Alabama Board of Electrical Contractors by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the number of potential future provisional licenses that would no longer be
issued by the board pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
This bill also provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Electrical Contractors until
October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
Page 1

FN-98VTBBB-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 122
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 122 as passed the Senate would reduce potential future receipts to the Alabama
Board of Electrical Contractors Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of
new provisional licenses that would no longer be issued by the Alabama Board of Electrical
Contractors pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
